distanthorizons_save_folder_weak_keys.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent call in ClientOnlySaveStructure.getSaveFolder and on the ConcurrentHashMap.values() call in its toString: both go to a table of this structure (a ConcurrentHashMap of weak identity keys, hashed by the wrapper's identity hash code like DH's map, and strong File values; never shrunk, so its entry count, bins and iteration order are DH's); DH's own function computes each folder, once per wrapper, with the wrapper as its argument; keys whose class overrides equals or hashCode go to DH's map. Helper bons.furious.patch.distanthorizons_level_wrappers.WeakFolders (runtime flag distanthorizonsSaveFolderWeakKeys, read at a structure's first call; shadow mode compares every answer and every toString with DH's own map). Fix: one old ClientLevel per visited level stayed in memory through the save folder map until the player left the server.
distanthorizons_save_folder_weak_keys.license: LGPL-3.0 (Distant Horizons 3.3.2): no Distant Horizons code is carried; the mixin wraps two map calls of ClientOnlySaveStructure and hands DH's own folder function on (helper bons.furious.patch.distanthorizons_level_wrappers.WeakFolders)

distanthorizons_keyed_level_pins.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Map.get (ordinal 0) and Map.put calls in KeyedClientLevelManager_neoforge.getServerKeyedLevel: the put stores the new ServerKeyedClientLevelWrapper_neoforge behind a weak reference and pins it on its ClientLevel (an Object[] field ClientLevelKeyedPinsMixin adds to ClientLevel, pairs cache map, wrapper); the get opens the reference. The wrapper lives exactly as long as its level; every lookup returns the same object as before. Helper bons.furious.patch.distanthorizons_level_wrappers.KeyedLevelPins (runtime flag distanthorizonsKeyedLevelPins, read at every store; shadow check of every hit against the level's pin). Fix: the last ClientLevel of every other dimension stayed in memory until that dimension was visited again.
